question: How many arches may be placed on the entablature when a great arch is on the spire?
premises: A great arch is present on the spire.
Eight arches may be placed on the entablature.
Alternatively sixteen arches may be placed.
inference: With a great arch on the spire, the entablature may have eight or sixteen arches.
plain_english: On the spire there is a great arch, and on the entablature there may be eight or sixteen.
